title: Construct mounts: jet, bike, horse, dragon
desc: Construct vehicles that form under the rider and move off, each in one of J's textures; J picked "construct vehicles and mounts (jet, motorbike, horse, dragon) in my textures".

takes.name: Jet
takes.facts: H1 hex; swept stepped wings, twin engines; rolls 6 blocks, lifts off, climbs to 9 blocks, banks +/-25 deg; forms under the rider front to back, ticks 1-24; 90% opaque

takes.name: Motorbike
takes.facts: W1 weave; spoked wheels, light trail; rides off, leans 22 deg into a turn; forms under the rider front to back, ticks 1-24; 90% opaque

takes.name: Horse
takes.facts: BR1 bricks; four-beat gallop, 10-tick stride, head and tail move with it; forms under the rider front to back, ticks 1-24; 90% opaque

takes.name: Dragon
takes.facts: X3D1 ripples; wings beat every 16 ticks, neck and tail wave, legs tuck, takes off and climbs; forms under the rider front to back, ticks 1-24; 90% opaque
